snippet.title: R-Type Dimensions III launching on May 19!  Here is another sneak peek (vol. 1)...
snippet.description:
The game is set to be released digital on MAY 19 on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch™ 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and PC (Steam). But only in digital form. Physical Editions are being delayed. Please read the full update here: 
https://iningames.com/blogs/news/r-type-dimensions-iii-pilot-briefing

The footage highlights both the classic R-Type gameplay players love and the refined modern presentation that will define this new entry. The game can be switched from old to new at any time during gameplay.

In addition, the team confirmed that the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of R-Type Dimensions III will be released as a complete physical edition on cartridge, containing the full game with no required downloads — a key commitment to collectors and preservation-minded players.

Pre-orders of the Special Edition and also the Standard Edition are still open, to be released on August 11. 

R-Type Dimensions III continues the franchise’s tradition of intense, precision-based shoot-’em-up action, bringing together classic 2D design and modernized visuals for a new generation of pilots — while remaining faithful to the series’ iconic DNA.

Key features include:
● A fully remastered experience with completely reconstructed assets
● Local co-op, enhanced with new scoring and survival mechanics
● Customizable controls and quality-of-life features in the settings
● 3D Camera settings (normal and crazy)

More information on http://www.iningames.com
